occurrences.text: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men upon the rocks of the wild goats.
Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?
The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
